name: meant
description: Shape Meant compositions with your own agent subscription through self-guiding, human-controlled tools.

interface.shortDescription: Shape Meant with your own agent.
interface.longDescription: Connect an agent to a new or existing Meant workspace, propose reversible composition drafts, inspect deterministic visual evidence in an embedded review surface, and Keep, Discard, or Undo work only through explicit human decisions.
defaultPrompt: Open my Meant composition and show the Exploring result before I decide whether to Keep it.
Create a reversible Meant draft from my brief, then inspect its visual evidence.
Review my current Meant composition and help me refine the selected element.
